text:
Emily: quick sync — we need a tiny decision on voice + naming before i merge the migration guide PR. do we standardize on "Redwood API" (short) or "Redwood Inference API" (explicit) across docs? :thinking_face:
Alex: i'd vote for the shorter "Redwood API" in tutorials and quickstarts, but use the full "Redwood Inference (API)" in security/enterprise pages where clarity matters.
Sam: +1 to Alex. also: should product names be Title Case (Dedicated, Private) everywhere? some pages use lowercase.
Maria: we should document that in the style guide. i'll add a small section under docs/style/branding.md. can someone confirm exact casing?
Ben: Product casing: Dedicated, Private, Console, Optimize — Title Case. SDK classes should be PascalCase (e.g., RedwoodClient). endpoints and routes lowercase (e.g., /v1/generate).
Emily: perfect. two other tiny calls: 
- wording for embeddings vs embedding API (singular noun in headings?)
- reference to "model variants" vs "model families" in routing docs
Alex: embeddings: headings use singular noun everywhere else (e.g., "Tokenization" not "Tokenizations"), so "Embedding" for section headings, "embeddings" in body text is fine.
Sam: on model language: customers say "model family" when comparing architectures, but internally we often say "variant" for a specific quantized or trimmed copy. propose glossary pair: "model family" -> umbrella, "model variant" -> specific config.
Maria: i can add those two glossary entries in docs/glossary.md and link to them from routing and optimize pages. assigning to me.
Ben: for SDK snippets i found a mismatched call in the migration guide — it references client.textGenerate() but our python SDK is client.generate_text(). small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (WIP)
Emily: thanks — Ben please push a quick fix. Sam can you review?
Sam: yep. will review after standup. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: Reminder: new style guide section created at docs/style/branding.md by Maria. Preview link: https://deploy-preview.example.com/docs/style/branding (expires in 7 days)
Maria: uploaded initial patch for glossary entries and casing examples. still needs wording polish.
Emily: decision summary so I can merge:
- Use "Redwood API" in tutorials/quickstarts; use "Redwood Inference API" in enterprise/security pages.
- Product names Title Case. SDK types PascalCase, endpoints lowercase.
- Headings use singular form for product features (e.g., "Embedding").
- Add glossary entries for "model family" and "model variant" with those definitions.
- Ben to fix SDK snippet; Sam to review. Maria to update style guide and glossary.
Alex: i'll run a quick grep for inconsistent token in docs/ and send a tiny PR for obvious casing mismatches.
Ben: PR updated and ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — changed client.textGenerate -> client.generate_text, fixed a couple of param names.
Sam: reviewed and left 2 minor nit comments.
Maria: i'll fold in the nit comments and push updated glossary. aiming to merge today.
Emily: awesome. if anyone finds other inconsistent microcopy, drop it here and we can batch fixes into a single patch. :sparkles:
